status: frozen before any window was scored; run_study.py lock wrote protocol_lock.json with this file's sha256 before the first score, and run, parity and render refuse a protocol whose sha256 differs from the lock
contract_note: Every arm (candidate, both comparators) and every M1 incumbent runs under this one contract: direction both, the single tiered_tp_pct close owner (+3%, full position), the single fixed entry-ATR stop owner (1.0 x ATR), strict close capability checks, the same capital, sizing and execution costs. Incumbents receive it through eval_windows compute_incumbent_legs(contract=...).

bounds.k_long: finite number strictly above 0 and at most 2
bounds.k_short: finite number strictly above 0 and at most 2
bounds.session_start_hour: integer 0 through 23 whose boundary lies on the candle grid
bounds.expected_interval_ms: positive integer that divides 86400000 exactly; bound per group from the timeframe
bounds.combined: (lookback_sessions + 1) x (86400000 / expected_interval_ms) <= 200, the default Go and Python check window
bounds.types: booleans, strings, nulls and non-integral values are refused where an integer is required

parameters.initialization: a decision on a bar needs the immediately preceding lookback_sessions complete, consecutive daily sessions and every candle of the current session from its exact opening candle through the decision bar; anything less holds with a reason (insufficient_history or the defect found)
parameters.equality: a close exactly equal to a threshold emits no entry; entries need a close strictly above anchor + k_long x range or strictly below anchor - k_short x range
parameters.events: at most one raw entry per side per session, consumed on the first crossing bar whether or not a position, regime or risk rule suppresses it
parameters.grid_order: itertools.product over the grid keys in the order listed; this order breaks the final selection tie
parameters.grid_exclusions: every grid point is checked with the registry validator for each group's interval before scoring; a refused point is excluded and listed with the refusal text (none is expected at 1h or 4h: the largest span is (7 + 1) x 24 = 192 bars)
parameters.alternate_boundaries: session_start_hour values other than 0 are verification cases in the integration tests; they are never scored
parameters.comparator_params: registry default_params of breakout and session_breakout, frozen; comparators are not tuned

proxy.inputs: study_manifest.json: byte-identical copies of the chande_momentum_1661 frozen Binance US 1h and 4h candles and Hyperliquid hourly funding under data/proxy/
proxy.label: proxy evidence: Binance US spot USDT candles stand in for Hyperliquid perpetual prices; this is not measured Hyperliquid candle evidence
proxy.funding_note: eval_windows run_leg with funding_mode charge on every candidate, comparator and incumbent leg, priced from the rebuilt offline cache; a leg holding a position in an hour with neither a rate nor a venue-absent mark is funding_incomplete. Hyperliquid funding starts in May 2023, so 2023 legs that hold positions before the first rate are funding_incomplete.
departures_from_m1_windows: oos end pinned at 2026-10-01 (M1 leaves it open)
2025H1 ends at 2025-06-10 (M1: 2025-07-01) so it cannot overlap the is selection window
proxy.start_of_window_history: non-manifest M1 legs load only each window's candles, so the first (lookback_sessions + 1) sessions of every window cannot fire (insufficient_history); the report records the held bars per leg. Comparators and incumbents also start cold at each window.
proxy.cost_model: the engine's Hyperliquid fee (commission) and default slippage per fill; this legacy M1 screen has no spread replay, lot rounding or minimum order, so it cannot by itself establish venue execution parity

venue.inputs: venue_manifest.json: byte-identical copies of the aroon_trend_1643 frozen Hyperliquid 4h candles, hourly funding, venue meta and L2 snapshot under data/venue/
venue.label: venue evidence: Hyperliquid mainnet perpetual candles
venue.warmup: the manifest warmup_bars (300) precede each window: the evaluator reads them, the engine neither scores nor trades them
venue.funding: the manifest's existing funding attachment and coverage semantics (attach_funding_cost); no --funding option applies on this path
venue.execution: the manifest execution specification with the explicit close owner: taker and maker fee, per-coin half spread plus slippage, szDecimals lot rounding, the venue minimum notional with its margin
venue.stress_note: cost x2 doubles half spread and slippage; fees are unchanged

selection_rule.who: candidate only, per group (proxy 1h, proxy 4h, venue 4h), on that group's selection window
selection_rule.eligible: every dataset scored; no funding_incomplete leg; no liquidated leg; no funding row fetched while scoring; at least min_training_clusters independent position clusters pooled across the group's datasets; venue only: candle and funding coverage complete
selection_rule.objective: highest mean Sharpe across the group's datasets, then highest mean drawdown-adjusted return, then earliest grid order
selection_rule.no_eligible: the group verdict is inconclusive; the seed is scored for the record only

sample_rules.cluster_definition: positions pooled across a group's datasets, sorted by entry time; overlapping holding spans merge into one independent cluster

proxy_group.scorable_window: a held-out window is scorable when every candidate, comparator and incumbent leg of the group exists and none is funding_incomplete; missing funding is never filled with an assumed zero rate

checks.m1_oos_pass: contract-aware M1 verdict pass in oos; unknown when oos is unscorable
checks.m1_secondary_passes: M1 verdict pass in at least 2 of 2023, 2024, 2025H1; true once 2 scorable passes exist, false once scorable passes plus unscorable secondary windows are below 2, else unknown
checks.oos_net_positive: candidate summed oos net PnL > 0; unknown when oos is unscorable
checks.oos_beats_breakout_sharpe: candidate oos mean Sharpe > breakout oos mean Sharpe; unknown when oos is unscorable
checks.oos_beats_session_breakout_sharpe: candidate oos mean Sharpe > session_breakout oos mean Sharpe; unknown when oos is unscorable

proxy_group.order: no eligible selection -> inconclusive; oos unscorable -> inconclusive; oos candidate clusters < min_held_out_clusters -> inconclusive; any check false -> fail; every check true -> pass; else inconclusive

venue_group.evidence_complete: provenance kind venue, candle and funding coverage complete, and no funding_incomplete candidate, comparator or incumbent leg at either cost multiplier

checks.net_positive_x1: candidate summed test net PnL > 0 at cost x1
checks.net_positive_x2: candidate summed test net PnL > 0 at cost x2
checks.m1_test_pass_x1: contract-aware M1 verdict pass on test at cost x1
checks.beats_breakout_sharpe_x1: candidate mean Sharpe > breakout at cost x1
checks.beats_session_breakout_sharpe_x1: candidate mean Sharpe > session_breakout at cost x1

venue_group.order: evidence incomplete -> inconclusive; no eligible selection -> inconclusive; test candidate clusters at x1 < min_held_out_clusters -> inconclusive; any check false -> fail; every check true -> pass

verdict_rules.overall: pass only if proxy 1h, proxy 4h and venue 4h all pass; fail if any group is fail; otherwise inconclusive
verdict_rules.metadata: edge_status stays no_edge after every outcome; pass keeps edge_source unvalidated, fail records study_fail, inconclusive records study_inconclusive; no outcome approves deployment or adds allow_no_edge

reporting: every training variant and exclusion per group, the held-out metrics of every variant as a diagnostic that never changes the selection, net results, drawdown, turnover, symbol and side concentration, independent position clusters, neighbouring-grid stability, funding coverage and provenance, the exact data venue, source and funding hashes, fees, spread, slippage, rounding, minimums, capital, leverage, sizing and stop assumptions, and a per-entry audit of the evaluated inputs and indicator values
